name: Deluge: Sermon for the Dead
source:
From the depths I call to thee—
—Lord, hear my cries for mercy.

Spring has come to Abbotsford — while Abe is growing increasingly preoccupied with his duties for the school paper, Rika solicits him to track down a set of human skulls that vanished from the island a century ago. It isn't long into their search that he finds out this macabre treasure holds disturbing significance to her.

In the meantime, campaigning has begun for the town council elections. While political infighting rises to an all time high, Marisa — the new girl in town — takes center stage. Will she be able to bring stability before all things converge in a tidal wave of deep despair?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2186980/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
自深渊中，我向你呼唤——
——主啊，求你垂听我的哀求。

春天来到了阿伯茨福德。Abe越来越专注于校报工作，而Rika请他帮忙寻找一批人类头骨；这些头骨一个世纪前就从岛上消失了。调查开始后不久，他便发现，这些阴森的遗物对Rika有着令人不安的重要意义。

与此同时，市议会选举已经拉开序幕。政治斗争愈演愈烈，而新来的Marisa也成为众人关注的焦点。在一切汇聚成绝望的浪潮之前，她能否让局势恢复稳定？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2186980/]Steam[/url]]
